info.title: DAS Organisation API
info.description: Organization-level administration of a DAS installation: the Network registry and each Network's feature switches, the current Network and its API keys, and the directory - users, groups and the roles they hold on the Organization layer and in each Network, and the Network tokens people enter a Network with (domains and branding follow). Conventions (docs/engineering/api-conventions.md): JSON in camelCase, instants in `*At` fields as ISO-8601 UTC, ids as prefixed ULIDs, money as the Money object. Errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` with a machine `code`. Every mutation requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Authentication is a bearer credential - an API key `das_<networkId>_<secret>` or an Organization session token; the Network a request acts for is ALWAYS the credential's, never a request parameter. The only paths that name a Network (`/api/networks/{networkId}/...`) are Organization-layer administration of that Network by an Organization credential - never the tenant of a Network-layer request. On a Network host (`<network>.<module>.<org domain>`) the host must name the credential's Network (403 `NETWORK_HOST_MISMATCH`). 401 and 403 problems apply to every authenticated operation.

resources.name: network
resources.description: A Network of the Organization: a tenant with its own host label, time zone and default currency. The API never deletes a Network, so destroy only forgets it, and a change to an attribute is refused at plan.

destroy.reason: A Network is never deleted through the API; destroy leaves it and its data in place.

resources.name: network_feature
resources.description: A feature switch of a Network. Every feature is OFF for a Network until switched on; destroy switches it off again.

destroy.reason: A feature is off unless switched on; destroy switches it off.

resources.name: organization_setting
resources.description: The Organization's value of a setting of the settings catalog (an `org` or `org-default` setting). Destroy clears it.

resources.name: network_setting
resources.description: A Network's own value of a setting (an override of the Organization's default). Destroy clears it, and the Organization's value applies again.

resources.name: user
resources.description: A person of the Organization's directory, invited by email. They hold no role until one is bound. The API never deletes a person: destroy suspends them.

destroy.reason: People are suspended, never deleted (their audit trail stays).

resources.name: group
resources.description: A group of people of the Organization's directory; role bindings name it.

resources.name: group_member
resources.description: A person's membership of a group.

resources.name: org_role_binding
resources.description: An Organization-layer role held by a person (by email) or a group (by name).

resources.name: network_role_binding
resources.description: A role in the Network named by `network_id`, held by a person or a group, administered by the Organization.

resources.name: role_binding
resources.description: A role in the credential's own Network, held by a person or a group, administered with a Network credential.

resources.name: api_key
resources.description: An API key of the credential's own Network, minted with a Network credential. Its token never enters Terraform state: the API writes it to the installation's secret store and `secret_ref` names the version (read it at runtime, e.g. an ephemeral aws_secretsmanager_secret_version). A key never exceeds its minter. Destroy revokes it and deletes the stored token.

resources.name: network_api_key
resources.description: An API key of the Network named by `network_id`, minted by the Organization. Its token never enters Terraform state: the API writes it to the installation's secret store and `secret_ref` names the version. Destroy revokes it and deletes the stored token.

resources.name: org_api_key
resources.description: An Organization API key (`daso_<secret>`): the Organization layer's machine credential, holding one Organization role, for Terraform and CI. Its token never enters Terraform state: the API writes it to the installation's secret store and `secret_ref` names the version. A key never holds more than its minter. Destroy revokes it and deletes the stored token.

resources.name: scim_token
resources.description: A SCIM token the identity provider provisions the directory with. Its secret never enters Terraform state: the API writes it to the installation's secret store and `secret_ref` names the version, for the identity provider's configuration. Destroy revokes it and deletes the stored secret.

resources.name: sign_in_policy
resources.description: How people sign in to the Organization: local sign-in, MFA, session length. One per Organization; destroy leaves the policy as it is.

destroy.reason: The Organization always has a sign-in policy; destroy stops managing it.

resources.name: scim
resources.description: SCIM provisioning of the directory, on or off. Destroy switches it off.

destroy.reason: SCIM is off unless switched on; destroy switches it off.

resources.name: identity_provider
resources.description: An identity provider (OIDC or SAML) federated into the Organization's sign-in. A client secret is a write-only attribute: it never enters Terraform state.

resources.name: email_sender
resources.description: The sender of an email purpose (local part, display name, Reply-To) on the Organization's email domain. Destroy goes back to the purpose's default sender.

bearer.description: An API key `das_<networkId>_<secret>` (bound to one Network), an Organization session (the Organization's Cognito access token) or a Network token (minted by `POST /api/networks/{networkId}/session-tokens`, bound to one Network).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key, 1-255 printable ASCII characters (a UUID is fine). A retry with the same key and request replays the first response; the same key with a different request is 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Correlation id, 1-128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`; echoed in the response. A malformed or missing one is replaced by `req_<ULID>`.

NetworkIdPath.name: networkId
NetworkIdPath.description: The Network administered, `net_<ULID>`. Organization layer only: an Organization admin managing that Network.

FeatureIdPath.name: featureId
FeatureIdPath.description: A feature id of the feature registry (kebab-case). An id the registry does not know is 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

SettingKeyPath.name: key
SettingKeyPath.description: A key of the settings catalog, `<domain>.<kebab-name>`, e.g. `delivery.accent-color`. A key the catalog does not know is 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

EmailPurposePath.name: purpose
EmailPurposePath.description: An email purpose, `<domain>.<kebab-name>`: `platform.sign-in` (Sign-in), `platform.notifications` (Notifications). A purpose the catalog does not know is 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit it for the first page.

ApiKeyIdPath.name: keyId
ApiKeyIdPath.description: The API key, `key_<ULID>`, of the Network (the credential's, or the one in the path).

XRequestId.description: The request id: the client's well-formed X-Request-Id, else a generated `req_<ULID>`.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored response of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

Forbidden.description: The credential may not do this (`NO_ACCESS`, `INSUFFICIENT_ROLE`, `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`, `ORG_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`, `NETWORK_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED`, `NETWORK_HOST_MISMATCH`, `FEATURE_DISABLED`)

NotConfigured.description: This installation is not configured for the operation (`NOT_CONFIGURED`)

SecretStoreRefused.description: The secret could not be delivered to the secret store: none, or one that refuses the name (`NOT_CONFIGURED`), or one that is unavailable (`UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, retry); nothing is minted

EmailRejected.description: The email service refused the message (`EMAIL_REJECTED`): `detail` says why, e.g. a recipient outside test mode or a suppressed address

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (`RATE_LIMITED`); `Retry-After` says when the next one may go, and `detail` says it in words

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request may go (RFC 9110)

InternalError.description: An unexpected failure (`INTERNAL_ERROR`); the request id names it in the service's logs

Money.description: An amount of money: a decimal string (never a JSON number) and its ISO-4217 currency.

slug.description: Host label of the Network (`<slug>.<module>.<org domain>`): 1-63 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens, not a reserved platform label (help, developer, api, www, module slugs, ...)

networkCode.description: The Network's code when it already has one (an import from another system), `NT-` and seven digits; omitted, a free code is assigned

NetworkCreate.description: A new Network. Time zone and default currency are required - there is no default.

value.description: The value, in the setting's format (its description says which): a string such as `#4fb0e8` for an accent color, or an object such as a Network's email branding

enabled.description: true switches the feature on for the Network, false off

FeatureSwitch.description: The new position of a Network's feature switch.

name.description: Name of the key; audit events show it as `service:<name>`

expiresAt.description: Optional: after this instant (ISO-8601 UTC, in the future) the key authenticates nothing (401 `CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED`). Omit for no expiry.

secretDelivery.description: `RESPONSE` (default): the secret is in this answer, once. `SECRET_STORE`: the API writes it as a new version to the installation's secret store and answers only its version-pinned reference `secretRef` (the secret field is null) - for Terraform, whose state never holds it

email.description: Their email; the first sign-in with it links their identity

displayName.description: New name shown in the UI

UserUpdate.description: A change of a user: name, status or both. Suspending ends their sessions at the next request and their Network tokens at the next exchange.

name.description: Unique name: 1-100 letters, digits, space, dot, underscore or hyphen

description.description: What the group is for (default empty)

externalId.description: The identity provider's group to map, or null

delete.summary: Revoke an API key of a Network
delete.description: Organization session with the `ADMIN` role and the scope `das:platform:api-keys:admin`. From now on the key authenticates nothing; it stays listed, with `revokedAt`. A token delivered to the secret store is deleted from it. Audited as `api-key.revoke`.

200.description: The revoked key (or, on a replay, the stored response)

get.summary: List who holds which role in a Network
get.description: Organization session with the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:read`. Organization administration of the Network in the path - never available to a Network-bound credential.

post.summary: Grant a role in a Network
post.description: Organization session with the `ADMIN` role and the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:admin`: the Organization layer grants every Network role, the four-eyes `APPROVER` included. Audited as `role-binding.create`.

requestBody.description: The role and who gets it

201.description: The binding (or, on a replay, the stored response)

get.summary: Get a role binding of a Network
get.description: Organization session with the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:read`. A binding of another Network is not found. Organization administration of the Network in the path - never available to a Network-bound credential.

delete.summary: Revoke a role in a Network
delete.description: Organization session with the `ADMIN` role and the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:admin`. Audited as `role-binding.delete`.

get.summary: List who holds which role in the Network of the credential
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:read` (an OPERATOR or NETWORK_ADMIN).

post.summary: Grant a role in the Network of the credential
post.description: Network-bound credential with the `ADMIN` role and the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:admin`, holding every permission of the role - a Network admin cannot make an `APPROVER`. Audited as `role-binding.create`.

requestBody.description: The role and who gets it

201.description: The binding (or, on a replay, the stored response)

get.summary: Get a role binding of the Network of the credential
get.description: Network-bound credential with the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:read` (an OPERATOR or NETWORK_ADMIN). A binding of another Network is not found.

delete.summary: Revoke a role in the Network of the credential
delete.description: Network-bound credential with the `ADMIN` role and the scope `das:platform:role-bindings:admin`, holding every permission of the role. Audited as `role-binding.delete`.
